Intake note (Commercial team, 19/05/2025). Our client Harpreet Pawar is a 72-year-old restaurant owner who lives at Flat 5D, Kadri, Mangaluru 575035 and can be reached on +91 76524 73557 or harpreet.pawar@example.in. The client's PAN VGYPP1110V.
The client consulted us about a breach of contract matter (Project Kestrel) against Deccan Logistics Ltd. The breach of contract claim against M/s Deccan Logistics Ltd is for Rs. 16,13,00,000; the counterparty has not paid the invoices for delivered goods.
The matter was filed as CS(COMM) 681/2025 before the Mangaluru Commercial Court on 16 September 2025.
